note: 31 measured regions: 15 exhibit rows (14 figure rows and one table row) and 16 exclusions. The paper prints 15 numbered figures and 4 numbered tables, so 19 exhibits; 15 are measured and 4 are declared gaps rather than given invented bboxes. Three of the gaps sit on the five pages whose text layer is empty and whose content the layout pass cannot see - p2, p5, p11, p12 and p24 are each flat inline rasters: p5 prints Table 1 'Notations used in this paper' ('Symbols | Description', twelve rows from P to beta_ij) and Table 2 'Well - known International Ecosystem Data Query Databases' ('Database Names | Database Websites Data', seven rows from INFOTERRA to FAO), p11 prints Figure 6 'Seasonal Ecosystem of North Temperate Wheat Fields', a circular spring-summer-winter diagram, and p12 prints Algorithm 1 'Discrete Dynamic Simulation Algorithm for Generalized Iterations' as twelve lines of pseudo-code. p2 is the contents page and p24 is the reference list. The fourth gap is different in kind and is the one worth carrying to the lane: Table 3 'The Parameter Values' is printed on p10, whose text layer is complete, and the layout returns no region for it because the grid is set as aligned symbol and value pairs with no rules at all - four columns of Symbols, Values, Symbols, Values over twelve rows (P0 100, Hn0 40, Hp0 40, C10 20, beta1 0.3076, beta2 0.5, alpha_n 0.78, alpha_p 0.6, alpha_0 0.0035, KHn 543, KHp 870, Kp 1000). Its rows and values are therefore recorded here from the text layer and not claimed as geometry. The measurable census is 14 of 15 figures and 1 of 4 tables, and the printed numbering has no hole: figures 1-15 and tables 1-4 are all present, only some are unmeasurable. Sixteen regions are excluded: seven fragment-of-other regions, one per (a)/(b) pair, and nine watermark blocks. Every pair carries ONE printed number, so each figure is one row plus one fragment - the same rule used on #423, #425, #427 and #428. On two pairs the extractor's region order is inverted: on Figure 11 and Figure 12 the first returned region is the RIGHT-hand panel, so the row records panel (b) and the fragment is panel (a); both row notes say so. Caption positions: all fourteen figure captions are printed BELOW their artwork and Table 4's caption ABOVE its grid. p25 is a designed one-page leaflet 'A Letter to Farmers', dated January 27 2025, which embeds a bar chart keyed 'Yield / Fruiting Rate' over 'Short Term' and 'Long Term' and a radar chart with axes SORE, SSR, PIR, CR and IGR; neither carries a printed number and the page returns no region at all, so it is declared here as not an exhibit and nothing is left unaccounted. Extractor defects, recorded as artefacts of the context pass and not as printing errors: the printed caption lines are clean, yet Figures 4 and 7 receive no caption record at all, so those two rows were keyed from their printed caption lines plus the '(a)'/'(b)' letters at y350 and y263; on Figure 9 the pass glues the following body sentence onto the caption ('Figure 9: Agro-Ecosystem' plus 'The species selected for this analysis were red fox and lynx ...'), and on Figure 15 it glues 'the model parameters k and alpha0 were varied from 10 to 20 and from 0 ...'; and it raises a second Figure 14 caption out of the body sentence that ends 'Figure 14.' One printed prose defect is real: p3 writes 'we have shown our work through the Figure 1'. Figure 4's y-axis exponent is not legible at audit resolution while Figures 5, 7, 10 and 15 print 'Energy(×10^7)' on the same axis, which is a raster legibility limit and not a confirmed printing error. The watermark carries its own text layer - '关注数学模型', '获取更多资讯', 'MATHmodels', 'Team # 2515136' and the folio - which is why the nine excluded watermark blocks return as vector regions with text inside them. The file has 25 sheets and the running folio reads 'Page N of 25' one below the sheet index on every sheet that prints one, because the title sheet is unnumbered; sheets 1, 2, 5, 11, 12, 24 and 25 print no folio.
